scope: Destination loading artwork, real progress counters and startup precache

display.preparationCounters: ready/required visible meshes, shadow casters and ancillary renderers

limitations: Automated checks use real application/SDK/worker code with controlled I/O and DOM/NullEngine fixtures; actual mobile rendering, thermal behavior and disk/network traces were not measured.
Persistent reuse requires available storage and the controlling resource service worker. Browser cache eviction or changed content requires only missing/new files.
Artwork is shown from application startup onward; the first HTML/JavaScript bundle fetch precedes application initialization.
